source.note: Built with the origin mechanism: COLANDER_WASM_SOURCE=path:<checkout of this commit> pnpm run build:wasm:release, with COLANDER_WASM_SHA256 set to artifactSha256. The commit is the v1.0.0 release commit plus the single follow-up fix that scopes the D-4 nesting check to repeaters (sibling PR #24), so the provenance chain is closed: there is no local patch. crates.io has no colander version, and the v1.0.0 GitHub release publishes only libcolander.so, so neither remote origin can supply the engine. See odd/tasks/repin-engine-1-0-0-github-release.md.

vectorsRecordedFrom.note: The five vector files are the frozen record and were NOT re-recorded. They come from this older revision and are replayed against the `core` above, which is the revision the vendored wasm was built from. `files` therefore pins the vectors, not the binary.
